newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Clerides threatens to walk out on Cyprus process.
newsitem.headline: Clerides threatens to walk out on Cyprus process.

text.p: Greek Cypriot President Glafcos Clerides threatened to pull out of negotiations with Turkish Cypriots if the European Union (EU) delayed the Cyprus entry talks set for early 1998.

"Not only I have no intention of delaying the (EU) process, but I must state that if there is any interference with (it), I won't be negotiating," Clerides told a news conference on Friday after talks between the island's two communities ended.
Clerides complained that a final U.N. statement which is due to come out within the hour did not give a thorough picture of what had happened during the five-day talks in Switzerland.
"At the end of the week we were exactly where we were when we came here," he said.
Earlier, at a separate news conference Turkish leader Rauf Denktash put the blame on the rival Greek Cypriots and the EU.

He accused the Greek Cypriots of blocking an accord by refusing to give Turks sovereign equality on the divided island and said the EU had thrown in a bombshell by its decision to start entry talks early next year for the Greek Cypriot government.
